baseline.note: Corrected occupied-cart boundary fixture; initial setup could not generate an offer with an occupied cart and was not a valid behavioral baseline.

scope: Decline a pending quote plus bounded valid contact form without adding or canceling existing cart
Validate whole contact form before partial persistence; quoted/question/conditional/duplicate/incomplete forms preserve prior state
Resume existing payment/final-confirmation step; no order before separate final confirmation
Eight real five-message coalesced bursts, two catalogs, mock agent on/off, empty/occupied carts
limits: Existing-cart quote coexistence seeded at session boundary; decisions pass through full router
No arbitrary mixed instructions or competing selection
Fixed delivery fee, mocked services and agent; no live geocoding or commercial conversion evidence
